mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fcc_call_session WHERE id=#{call} AND tenant_id=#{tenant}

SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id,CAST(call_id AS CHAR) AS callId,CAST(flow_version_id AS CHAR) AS versionId,status,current_step_key AS currentStep,context_json AS snapshot,started_at AS startedAt,ended_at AS endedAt FROM fcc_flow_instance WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND call_id=#{call} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id,step_key AS stepKey,action_type AS actionType,attempt_no AS attemptNo,status,command_id AS commandId,trigger_event_id AS eventId,input_json AS input,output_json AS output,error_code AS errorCode,started_at AS startedAt,ended_at AS endedAt,duration_ms AS durationMs FROM fcc_flow_step_execution WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND call_id=#{call} AND id > #{after} ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
